resources.string: No unanswered reminder in the last 60 seconds. Reminders must be on and Do Not Disturb off.
Enable Quick Tap / reminder action in the 440 app first.
Plays the requested pitch once within 60 seconds of a reminder, without shake detection. Also adds a Hear pitch action to the reminder notification. Normal app opening stays silent.

Enable Random reminders and Quick Tap / reminder action here. On your Pixel, go to Settings → System → Gestures → Quick Tap → Open app. Choose 440 · After reminder if listed. If the picker groups entries under 440, look for the Hear pitch after reminder shortcut. Do not select the ordinary 440 launch.

Use Test reminder, then try Quick Tap within 60 seconds. Quick Tap availability and screen-off or locked behavior depend on the phone. If its picker offers neither target, use the Hear pitch action on the reminder notification or the widget.

Shake after reminders can remain off for this alternative.
